visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with light brown hair and a grey sweater stands in an indoor domestic space, holding a black smartphone with a daisy-patterned case and a pearl-style wrist strap. She displays a social media interface on her screen while gesturing with her hands. The background is slightly out of focus, showing white cabinetry and a domestic environment. (2) The camera pans down to reveal a large brown cardboard shipping box for an LG PuriCare Dehumidifier. A smaller white unit is visible in a separate shot located in a laundry/balcony area where clothes are hanging on racks above it. (3) The woman begins unboxing the unit, using scissors to cut through the sealing tape. She pulls out various white plastic accessories including a manual, a Y-shaped attachment for shoes, and a flexible corrugated hose. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a well-lit apartment interior. (4) Close-up shots focus on the top of the white dehumidifier, which features a minimalist circular design and a digital touch control panel. The woman presses a circular button, causing a hidden handle to spring up. She then proceeds to peel off several strips of blue protective tape from the unit's body. (5) The unit is moved to the balcony area for a side-by-side comparison with an older, bulkier model. The new unit is sleek and white with a grey cord storage door at the back. The woman demonstrates the 360-degree caster wheels at the bottom by tilting the unit. (6) Final sequence shows the woman interacting with the control panel. The circular vent on top slowly opens upwards when the power is turned on. The surroundings include a white refrigerator, kitchen appliances, and storage bins on shelves.
